patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Hides banner, native, interstitial and sponsored ad tiles by treating the user as ad-free, the same state a Chefkoch PLUS subscriber has. Also skips the ad-consent (CMP) prompt.

patches.name: Remove analytics
patches.description: Drops Firebase Analytics events and user properties before they leave the app. Other telemetry (Snowplow, Audix) is handled by the Remove tracking patch.

patches.name: Remove tracking
patches.description: Neuters the app tracking middleware: no Snowplow events, no Admo Audix targeting and no Firebase tracking state changes are processed.
